entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Urban Commuter Helmet. It looks like it was delivered about 68 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I see. Could you elaborate for me? Is it an issue with the fit, or perhaps the color?
The color. Just don't like it.
I understand completely. We want you to be happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Has it been used?
No. The box is unopened. It's just been sitting here.
Excellent, that makes things very straightforward. Let me just confirm the policy... Yes, I see here that since the item was delivered 68 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window.
So you can process the return?

Absolutely. Since the box is unopened, I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next 5 to 10 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office.
Fine. About time something was simple.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be issued to the original payment method. Will there be anything else today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
